Text_lang: The Winter Queen has asked for you to deliver a message to Sire Denathrius, the Master of Revendreth. You will need his help for the coming conflict.
Test
Following an unprovoked assault on Bastion, you were tasked with journeying to Maldraxxus and investigating why the armies of the dead have betrayed their oath to defend the Shadowlands.

Using a set of blueprints you recovered and the destructive capabilities of the G.M.O.D. at your disposal, you and Gallywix managed to destroy an airship utilized by High Tinker Mekkatorque and set Alliance interests in Drustvar back even further.

Khadgar has summoned you to Dalaran to help him investigate a mysterious figure called the Harbinger who possesses a powerful relic called the Dark Heart. The Archmage has also asked Alleria Windrunner to join you in order to give her unique perspective.
You were summoned to Silithus to seek out Magni, the Speaker of Azeroth, in order to learn more about the mysterious Radiant Song being heard all across Azeroth.

Orweyna reveals that she found a recording from none other than Gallywix, the leader of the operations around Opportunity Point. But she is worried about what she heard behind a massive cave wall. Machines grinding and drilling with a purpose that remains hidden, for now...
You were summoned to Silithus to seek out Magni, the Speaker of Azeroth, in order to learn more about the mysterious Radiant Song being heard all across Azeroth.
With reagents gathered and souls recovered, you prepare to witness the somber fruits of Sylvanas' everlasting toil.

With the help of Xal'atath you have managed to beat back the void in the Oasis eco-dome. Soul-Scribe tasked you with collecting items for the coming Tabiqa ritual, though she does not have much faith that anything will come of trying to connect with K'aresh. The time has come to try, however, and your fate depends on whether Xal'atath is telling the truth...
Meeting with Brinthe and Dagran, you formed a plan to clear out the goblins in the Deepforge Golemworks and get the factory operational again.

Satisfied with your assistance, Ve'nari has given you his Reshii Ribbon. While powerful, the Ribbon is not enough on its own to stop Dimensius. Locus-Walker is aware of another in the keeping of his friend and fellow Ravel member, Om'bera. The decision is made to move on to Eco-dome Gammon but Alleria departs, stating that she will check on the situation with the Shadowguard. It is clear that she is not accepting of the presence of Xal'atath.

You witnessed a Steamwheedle scientist being forced to test Black Blood weapons, stabilized using kaja'mite. The successful test would allow Gallywix to use the kaja'mite and Black Blood to repair the Dark Heart.

At the edge of crackling amethyst glass, Xal'atath begins to weave her plan to draw the Wastelanders to your cause. Denizens of the void prowl the Tempest Fields, their presence a testament to the failing boundaries between K'aresh and the void. Xal'atath has brought you here with the promise of gaining the murderous Wastelanders as allies.

Orweyna bid you farewell, unable to travel with you further. Suddenly, a small spider arrived with a message for you--a request that you follow it to the sender. When you arrive, you meet the Widow Arak'nai, otherwise known as The Weaver--and she has a deal for you. If you help her try to take out the dark forces influencing Queen Ansurek, she'll help you find your friends.

You and the Arathi fought valiantly against the nerubian onslaught, but it was too much. Anduin sacrificed himself to allow you, Faerin, and Alleria to board the airship The Reckoning and rain fire down upon the nerubians.

You arrived at Faerin's Advance, where Faerin Lothar is collecting refugees from the nerubians. Oddly enough, these people have been escaping on their own. You are then tasked with meeting up with Flynn Fairwind. Together, you find vital intel about what's been going on--and you decide to sneak into Siegehold to investigate further while Flynn meets with the Weaver.
With the Oathsworn and Unbound united in purpose, Coreway access to the Ringing Deeps is restored. It will take much more time to clear the rest of the Coreway.
Dalaran rushed to the aid of Khaz Algar, only for the Archmage Drenden to reveal himself to be Xal'atath in disguise. She attacked Dalaran with an army of nerubians at her command.

In cave beneath the tower, the Order of Night worked to keep the tower dark. You fight them and escaped the confines of the cave with Faerin and Anduin, who revealed the grief they each struggle with. In performing a ritual to restore the Sacred Flame with Faerin, Anduin felt just a touch of the Light again.
Brinthe discovered ZZ-01-47, a small maintenance machine that was sending a distress signal from the Deepforge Golemworks.
Talking to Gundargaz citizens, you learned of other problems he's neglected. You decided to investigate an incursion of kobolds.
Moira received you both when you and Alleria returned to Dornogal. She asked you to signal when the combined fleets of the Horde and Alliance arrived.

Xal'atath has stunned Soul-Scribe with a tantilizing secret: K'aresh may not be dead after all. She suggests you all move to the Oasis to perform the Tabiqa ritual. Soul-Scribe is hessitant, but her daughter Narathe says that they must at least try to connect to the worldsoul. Soul-Scribe agrees to the attempt, but warns that Xal'atath's words had better not be false.

After a whirlwind battle out of the City of Threads and an intense encounter with Xal'atath, you returned to the Weaver's Lair to let her know what you learned. There is no redeeming Queen Ansurek--she is willingly working with Xal'atath. The Weaver thanks you for finding her another ally, and requests your presence when she reaches out to the General and Vizier, while Alleria and Anduin return to the surface.
With power restored and resources flowing to the Deepforge Golemworks, all that was left was to clear out the goblins.
With the Waterworks up and running again, you needed to head to the Shadowvein Extraction site and restore the flow of resources.
Renzik's death at the hands of Nikki the Fixer kicked off violence in the streets of Undermine.
With Pamsy's help, the Black Blood pumps were stopped. Now it is time to follow the Black Blood to it's destination, in Undermine.

Alleria and Faerin steered the ship recklessly into Azj'kahet in pursuit of Anduin's captors, but the nerubians were prepared. The Reckoning was entrapped in webs, and the Arathi forces scattered below.
You rushed back to Gundargaz, where you faced a conspiracy of Machine Speakers firmly loyal to the High Speaker and fought your way to the Hall of Awakening in pursuit of the High Speaker.

The Candle King has been bullying kobolds. You stole his crown and formed an alliance with the peaceful kobolds, like Skitter. After returning to Gundargaz, Dagran suggested you investigate suspicious events in a mining town called Taelloch. Moira returned to the surface to inform Adelgonn and her warriors.

Finding the fuses inoperative during the defense of the Cinderbrew Meadery, Baelgrim had no choice but to ignite the kegs himself. Queensguard Zirix was slain, but Baelgrim gave his life to enact his plan.
In the Archive in Dornogal, you met the rest of the acting Council of Dornogal, Speaker Brinthe and Councilward Merrix, and deposited a memory gem into the Archive.
Thrall and Jaina returned with the fleet and were eager to begin hunting Xal'atath. But first, they asked you to prepare a space for them in Dornogal.
The Council of Dornogal realized they could not rebuild the Coreway without the Unbound, the earthen who had abandoned their oaths. You and Baelgrim left to seek out the Unbound leader, Adelgonn.
Zirdo was promoted for his slimy ways by Gallywix to Overseer of the Heaps, but he will not live to commit another betrayal.
The Weaver has a lead that may be of interest and has asked you to investigate. What you find will surely benefit both your causes.

While fighting your way through the Shadowguards' forward base, Xal'atath revealed to Alleria and you that the Ravel used the Reshii Ribbons to destroy K'aresh in hopes that it would destroy Dimensius in the process. They have failed. 
Alleria's trust in her mentor, Locus-Walker, has now completely diminished. She is heading to Eco-Dome Primus to confront him.

You, Faerin, and Anduin traveled across Hallowfall and rescued villagers from the kobyss, against the orders of General Steelstrike. But then, a sudden blast of shadow darkened the land even farther. The three of you found the that the nearby Dawntower had been corrupted with a dark flame.
Stormward Baelgrim and his Stormriders thwarted the nerubian Queensguard Zirix's ambush, but an explosion in the earthen city of Dornogal called them and Dalaran's survivors to investigate.

Magni tried to commune with Azeroth to learn what the Radiant Song was warning us about but fell unconscious during the process. With the aid of the Dalaran archmages, there was still hope of recovery.
In Freywold, Adelgonn rebuffed Baelgrim. You and Moira gained her trust by rescuing her people.

Nikki the Fixer paid the price for killing Renzik, forcing Gallywix to retreat into his fortress-like casino. While he is safe from goblin justice for now, Gallywix no longer has his grip on the city and its people. A new era dawns for Undermine.
Gallywix and his Darkfuse have been spreading over Undermine, into the territory of friendly and hostile cartels.

Pamsy revealed she was the one who brought down the wall that brought your attention. She hoped getting outsider's attention could save her workers. But Zirdo betrayed you all for a reward and the Darkfuse Overseer had Pamsy's crew killed.

After assisting the Stormriders with the nerubians, Dalaran's survivors regrouped in Dornogal and went their separate ways: Jaina and Thrall to call reinforcements, Alleria to hunt Xal'atath, and the rest staying to help the earthen.
Unstable void energies have made this garrison largely inhospitable. Aid Locus-Walker in disabling it and saving K'aresh once and for all.

After fighting your way across the void glass and defeating the ravenous Zagithav the Essence Gorger, you are confronted by Soul-Scribe and her Wastelanders. Xal'atath, in an uncharacteristic moment, has shared the story of her own world's destruction by Dimensius. She promised the Wastelanders a chance at revenge, but the secretive ethereals do not make allies lightly. Perhaps showing them that you are on their side will help, while the Harbinger works her whispers.
After realizing that Locus-Walker has allied himself with Xal'atath, he wishes Alleria and you to join him as The Trust is ready to take the fight to the real enemy - The Shadowguard and Dimensius.

The Shadowguard use these umbral garrisons to funnel energy from K'aresh directly to Dimensius. While your allies seek to disrupt the Shadowguard, Xal'atath seeks only to defeat Dimensius. Join her and disable the buildings together.
The Shadowvein Extraction site was receiving power, but it was infested with rock worms! With ZZ-01-47's help, site operations could be restored.
You arrived in Taelloch with Magni and Dagran to search for the missing foreman. You found frightened survivors sequested in their homes... and evidence of earthen transforming into skardyn!

Most of the Shadowvein Extraction site was restored, with the large exception of the crushers in the nearby cave. Getting them moving again was vital before you could return to the Deepforge Golemworks.

You brought the faded crystal to Ve'nari. To her and everyone's amazement, the crystal is soul essence of K'aresh, a crumb of it that was not devoured by Dimmensius. You now have to take the shard to Eco-Dome A'dani, hoping that Ve'nari will be able to reason with Soul-Scribe. The future of K'aresh is on the edge of a dual-bladed sword.
Seeking to find allies against a common threat, you accompanied Anduin into Hallowfall in search of the Arathi.
Alleria joined you and the goblins in Undermine as you began your investigation of Noggenfogger's involvement.

A rocket drill has taken your band to Undermine, the center of goblin society. Pamsy's pal, Grimla Fizzlecrank, has volunteered to get you acquainted with the place so you can pick up the trail of the Black Blood.
Baelgrim wanted to rally the Stormriders to protect the Unbound from another nerubian attack on the Coreway, and went to the Stormperch in Storm's Watch to do so.

Orweyna has found the trail of the Black Blood again. Revilgaz and Blackwater are moving it through Undermine, and Ethereals seem to be lurking in the shadows. Orweyna set out to get Alleria to help as the rest of you went to question Revilgaz.

You then travelled to Mereldar and discovered that the Order of Night had been recruiting Arathi who gave into their fear of Beledar's Shadow. As you investigated, the kobyss attacked the Veneration Grounds, drawn by the Order of Night leader Aleric Leid's magic.

After Alleria destroyed Aleric Leid's shadow barriers, you slew him. But the Arathi were given no time to rest. The nerubians assaulted the town of Livia's Patience. You accompanied Faerin, Alleria, and Anduin to evacuate the town.

Your investigations and informants revealed Gallywix unleashed goblins to mine Black Blood, the substance that mutated the nerubians and empowered Xal'atath's Dark Heart. An informant named Zirdo seems willing to tell you more and lead you deeper into the caves.

Magni awoke with new insight into the Radiant Song. Azeroth has been trying to warn us that Khaz Algar, a titan installation from legend, is in danger. Dalaran will teleport to the island to defend it.

You helped reunite the haranir for their recovery, but their discontent remained. They were no longer willing to follow Orweyna in her pursuit of answers about the Black Blood. Orweyna must continue on through Hallowfall and then the Ringing Deeps.

You and Speaker Brinthe arrived in the Ringing Deeps to meet the Machine Speakers. The local leader, the High Speaker, was obsessed with restoring a titan Awakening Machine that shut down millennia ago. Unable to recharge their life force, long-lived earthen are shutting down one by one.

Having defeated the Shadowguard and disrupted Dimensius at every other garrison, the moment has come to confront their leaders. Nexus-Prince Azir was promoted for his deception in stealing the Dark Heart from Xal'atath. With Alleria's aid, take him down and strike a lethal blow to the Shadowguard threat.
You discovered Venture was running a kaja'mite mine in Zuldazar, and trading the kaja'mite to Gallywix for weapons powered by Black Blood.

In Siegehold, you meet with the General Anub'azal. His position has been usurped by one of the "ascended" named Zev'kall. Anub'azal asks for your aid in ruining Zev'kall's reputation, offering to help you escape Siegehold with the other refugees in return. Upon successfully escaping, you return to the Weaver with news of this potential new ally.

The Weaver has a message for you from a mysterious figure known only as The Vizier. The Vizier has important matters to discuss, and requests your presence in the City of Threads--the nerubian capital city.

You helped reunite the haranir for their recovery, but their discontent remained. They were no longer willing to follow Orweyna in her pursuit of answers about the Black Blood. Orweyna must continue on alone in Hallowfall, seeking answers beneath Beledar's glow.

You headed to the airdocks at Tenir's Ascent to defend against the nerubian forces. There, Alleria reappeared and with her help you defeated the nerubian leader of the assault. You learned she had been tracking the nerubians who attacked Dalaran.

After familiarizing yourself with the Weaver's Lair, she offers you the first of her favors--if you investigate the goings-on in and around the military headquarters known as Siegehold, she'll give you the location of some of your allies. The Weaver is in search of allies of her own, and if you follow her lead, perhaps you can find another similarly-minded nerubian to ally with.

Locus-Walker's betrayal by his scout, Raz'ida, had a frightening development where Xal'atath transformed you into energy using a powerful artifact known as the Reshii Ribbon. You intercepted an encrypted message about "The Eco-Dome Project" and experienced firsthand the immense destructive powers that Dimensius still possesses, even in his fractured form.
It is now the time to visit one of the eco-domes and meet Locus-Walkers' "friend", who will lend us their Reshii Ribbon.

In the Abyssal Excavation, you discovered that there are experimental machines using strange fuel and that the operation is led by Jastor Gallywix. You also found Renzik, a goblin spy for the Alliance seeking the same answers. But Orweyna was worried about what she heard behind a massive cave wall. Machines grinding and drilling with a purpose that remained hidden...
Orweyna and you attacked the Black Blood pumps, but a goblin engineer, Pamsy, pointed out that a direct attack on the pumps would make things worse.

You and Anduin saw a crystal as bright as the sun, then Anduin once more heard the Radiant Song. You both encountered a lamplighter named Faerin who recruited you for a mission to rescue soldiers at the Fallen Aegis Wall.
Brinthe asked you to scout the defunct golem factory, working with ZZ-01-47.  The Alliance of the Deeps needed a way to get the factory up and running again.

Baelgrim found the Stormriders in the Stormperch had been corrupted by some dark power. With their forces almost wiped out, the Stormriders cannot protect Dornogal. Baelgrim devised a new plan to battle the nerubian threat at the Cinderbrew Meadery.
After Xal'atath's attack, Dalaran crashed on the Isle of Dorn. The city's survivors worked to repel a waiting nerubian ambush.
Ready for all enemies, you and the coalition take on Xal'atath's forces in the pursuit of stopping her.

You have traveled to the Broker city of Tazavesh, now relocated to the ruins of K'aresh. There you have learned that the Brokers and the Etherials are working together to rebuild the remains of their shattered homeworld. However, not all appears to be going well as you have encountered multiple instances of sabotage, setting back the rebuilding effort.
After leaving the Deepforge Golemworks with all armies assembled, Xal'atah strikes the coalition just as you're all in place.
Brinthe became the next High Speaker, pledging the Machine Speakers' support against the nerubians.
The Waterworks is infested by troublesome kobolds and vindictive elementals. Getting it up and running again seemed like quite a challenge, but Dagran offered his help.

You rushed back to Noggenfogger to find he was under attack by Ethereals, who were also after the Dark Heart. With Alleria's help you fought them off, but the race is on. You need to reach the Dark Heart, and the hostages Gallywix is using to control the other trade princes, before your enemies do.

Dalaran's survivors reached Dornogal and found the earthen in disarray due to an ongoing nerubian attack. They also found the Coreway, an earthen-forged passage to Azeroth's core, had been sabotaged in the attack.

Collaborating with Brinthe and Dagran, you made a plan. First, get the Waterworks up and running again to restore power. At the Shadowvein Extraction Site, restore the flow of materials and resources for war golem construction. And, with old-fashioned mayhem, draw the goblins out of the Golemworks and reactivate the factory before they can respond.

Having gathered all Reshii wraps and disrupted Dimensius to the best of your ability, the time has come to face Dimensius head on. Your allies maintain a fragile alliance with the understanding that nothing is more important than defeating Dimensius. Is best not to leave anything unsaid in these final moments of preparation.
At the Aegis Wall, you helped Faerin, Anduin, and the Lamplighter Kyron light the keyflame and blunt the nerubian assault.

The High Speaker reactivated the Awakening Machine with Xal'atath's artifact... and an overload suffused him with Void energy! Transformed and overwhelmed, he fled. At that moment, Magni realized a new potential within himself: he entered the Awakening Machine... emerging transformed by the World Soul. His actions allowed a new generation of earthen to awaken, led by the first among their kind: Dawn.

You and Orweyna decimated Venture Co.'s stockpile of Black Blood weapons. Nikki the Fixer harried you with her nigh-invincible Executive Package, but Pamsy handed off parts to Gazlowe that may let him invent a weapon to defeat her. Gazlowe arrived with a city's worth of goblins ready to march on Gallywix's casino and take back Undermine.
Noggenfogger is working for Gallywix against his will. He couldn't say much, but he did set you on the trail of Venture Company's kaja'mite mines.

Khadgar has summoned you to Dalaran to help him investigate a mysterious figure called the Harbinger who possesses a powerful relic called the Dark Heart. The Archmage has also asked Alleria Windrunner to join you in order to give her unique perspective.
In Hallowfall, you found Orweyna with the other haranir also investigating the Black Blood. But they were in dire straits.

Dimensius, the All-Devoureing, is no more. You have won, champion. As the void settles, a faded crystal laid on the cold floor. It is an unusual crystal that pulses when you touch it, a feint voice whispers an elegy in your mind. There must be someone who knows what this crystal is.
You were summoned to Silithus to seek out Magni, the Speaker of Azeroth, in order to learn more about the mysterious Radiant Song being heard all across Azeroth.
After power was restored to the titans' machines, the Archives came online. Dagran and Brinthe discovered a new chamber beneath Dornogal while the Horde and Alliance finalized their plans.
Adelgonn rejoined the Council and the Unbound and Oathsworn began working together again. The Unbound started repairing the Coreway after receiving orders from Merrix.

The journey to Dimensius will be long and full of his underlings. Having faced the Shadowguard multiple times already, Alleria will not overlook any opportunity to thin their numbers. Defeat them and uncover any secrets that lie in the sands.

After helping Ve'nari stabilize and protect Eco-Dome Primus, you are now headed to the Serrated Peaks, taking the fight to the enemy. 
You sense a looming shadow as if something is not right. Something is being kept away from you. Perhaps Xal'atath's presence and ability drive you into madness and doubt in your own logic. 
For now, Alleria and you will conduct a series of small-scale missions within the enemy base, ensuring the future survival of the Eco-Dome Project.

You and Gazlowe couldn't stop Nikki the Fixer, but the revolution rages on. Gazlowe stayed behind to rally the people of Bilgewater and sent you to deal with the Black Blood smugglers at the Blackwater Marina.

After saving the soldiers you could, Faerin Lothar sent you to look into the mysterious figure who aided you during the airship attack. You encounter her underground, where she is investigating a substance known as Black Blood. Orweyna asks for your help in cleaning things up--but it appears that the haranir, as her people are called, aren't happy with her efforts at diplomacy.

Your investigation into the sabotague in Tazavesh has revealed that the Shadowguard, Etherials who strive to resurrect the void lord Dimensius, are culprits!
Unfortunately, as you share the news of your discovery to your allies the Shadowguard unleashed an overwhelming attack upon the city!
After preparing the Cinderbrew Meadery to defend against the nerubians, Baelgrim enacted his plan to lure the nerubians into the meadery and then ignite the explosive cinderbrew kegs.
High Speaker Brinthe discovered a mysterious signal originating from an abandoned war golem facility in the Ringing Deeps.
You arrived to find goblins have set up a major operation. Time to investigate the work camps and find out what they are after.
Brinthe summoned you back to her abode in Gundargaz so you could make more plans.
The trail of the Black Blood has led to Gallywix, Darkfuse oppression and a mysterious ethereal, but the painful blow was discovering Marin Noggenfogger is somehow involved.

Clearing the goblins out of the manufacturing bay was not easy. Brinthe's plan was to cause mayhem outside of the manufacturing bay, drawing the goblins out one by one. Then you planned to proceed into the manufacturing bay, where you could reactivate the golemworks.

Having secured the help of your new Wastelander allies, it is time to reunite with Alleria Windrunner. She has called her own people to help aid her against the Shadowguard, but they are proving to be powerful and resilient foes. Reconnect your allies and unite around a single motivation to defeat Dimensius.

Arator, son of Alleria, seeks the council of his family--but the living Windrunners are scattered to the winds. Accompany Arator as he seeks  Vereesa in the ruins of Dalaran, and together uncover hints of an ominous future yet to pass.

You and your allies have heroically worked to halt the Shadowguard attack upon Tazavesh and reinforce the city's protective shield. As you defeated the leader of the Shadowguard forces Locus-Walker introduced us to his mysterious ally... Xal'atath!
Alleria was not happy with this revelation.

You helped Fleetmaster Seahorn reclaim the Blackwater Marina and stop the flow of Black Blood into the Undermine. Grimla, Pamsy, and Orweyna need your aid to stop Venture Company loyalists from turning their existing stockpiles into new weapons.
Revilgaz has no loyalty to Gallywix and is willing to help you out. He sent you to a drop site where the Black Blood was sent to be distributed.

Soul-Scribe performed the Tabiqa ritual using the items you gathered. It was not going well, until Xal'atath stepped in. The Harbinger drained the energy from the Wastelanders, boosting the ritual spell. Soul-Scribe's anger was swiftly changed to wonder as she heard the voice of K'aresh for the first time since the sundering of the world. Awed and grateful, she has pledged herself and her people to fight by your side against Dimensius, and will turn over her Reshii Ribbon.

Eco-dome: Rhovan was destroyed by a meteor and was overrun by void-touched creatures. A Wastelander dagger, once used for the Tabiqa ritual, was found buried in Om'bera's chest, with her Reshii Ribbon nowhere in sight. Due to his part in helping the Ravel destroy K'aresh, the Wastelanders are hunting Locus-Walker and will attempt to kill him on sight. Xal'atath believes the Wastelanders will be useful in the coming battle against Dimensius and encouraged Locus-Walker to stay behind while the two of you work towards gaining their aid.
The Lamplighters ignited the dawntower at Tenir's Ascent just in time. The star Beledar shifted to shadow, bringing darkness to Hallowfall.
You met Monte Gazlowe on his way to Opportunity Point. He needed help sniffing out a suspicious new operation there. Orweyna followed to see if this is connected to her vision.

You found the foreman, who had sealed herself inside a cave before transforming into a tormented skardyn. After slaying her, we found a memory gem with further revelations: the High Speaker and Xal'atath plan to "reawaken" all the earthen as skardyn!

The hostages were freed, but Gallywix has escaped, and the Dark Heart was taken by one of the ethereals. Gazlowe seems to have lost his will to fight for Undermine. Alleria had to leave and continue her hunt for the Dark Heart.

The Deepforge Golemworks is back up and running, existing War Golems are reactivating, and the Golemworks is producing more. It was time to return to Dornogal and relay your message of success, speaking with the Machine Speaker emissary there.

Using pheromones that you obtained in Siegehold, you manage to make your way into the city without being attacked. The Vizier is revealed to be Executor Nizrek--Queen Ansurek's closest advisor, in theory--and he has Anduin Wrynn with him. You are tasked with viewing the Ascension Day speech and witnessing Ansurek's willing embrace of darker powers.

You arrived in the Ohn'ahran Plains to reach the green dragonflight and help them empower the Emerald Oathstone. To do so, you had to establish diplomacy with the Maruuk centaur so that you could cross their lands.

You met Scout Tomul of Clan Shikaar and aided her hunting party in taking down a proto-dragon. She introduced you to Sansok Khan, the deaf leader of Clan Shikaar. She shared that the green dragons were sending an emissary to the centaur's upcoming gathering and agreed to bring you along if you pulled your weight.

You traveled alongside the caravan, sharing stories and hunting alongside them during the journey. You helped their mystic, Ohn Seshteng, receive a bleak omen from their god, Ohn'ahra, before arriving in Maruukai.

You fought off a primalist attack in Camp Antonidas before traveling to the Azure Archives. There, you discovered the Azure Oathstone and the simulacrum of Sindragosa, former prime consort of the blue dragonflight.

Together with Kalecgos and Khadgar, you stopped Raszageth's plans. She turned her fury on Kalecgos, but a group of blue dragons arrived just in time to protect him. Furious, Raszageth flew off, leaving Kalecgos and the others to return to the Azure Archives.

Although you successfully rescued the missing tuskarr, you also discovered something disturbing in the process. The gnolls appeared to be utilizing decay magic to taint and rot the land around them. Dismayed, Brena set out to investigate the apparent source of the decay--Brackenhide Hollow.

You traveled to meet Kalecgos in the dragon capitol of Valdrakken. Atop the Seat of the Aspects, he warned the others of Raszageth's activities and the rise of Primalist agression. After uncovering insurgency within the city, you raced to the South Hold Garrison.
Upon arriving at the Wingrest Embassy, you were greeted by an eager drakonid cadet named Sendrax. Wrathion and the other dragons were nowhere to be found.

Your peaceful exploration was cut short when Raszageth, leader of the Primalists, led a direct assault on the Lifeshrine. Queen Alexstrasza took to the skies to fend off Raszageth while Majordomo Selistra and the rest of the dragonflight rallied to defend their home on the ground.

Nozdormu arrived just after Chromie and Eternus were lost. He informed you they were falling through time, creating ripples. He asked you to go to a possible future to try to recover them.

You stepped through a portal and discovered a Primalist Tomorrow. A potential future where the Primalists are winning against a small group of holdouts. While you were able to help the rebels, and met their leader, you! You could not stabilize Chromie.

Once the whelplings were safe, you fought your way into the djaradin volcanic fortress. With the help of Wrathion's spies and Majordomo Selistra, you ensured the djaradin would pose no more threat to their neighbors. At least for now.

You arrived in Maruukai for the centaur gathering, the Khural. You met the other powerful clans of the plains.

You met Clan Teerai, the tradition keepers, and helped cook an offering for the ancestors.

You met Clan Ohn'ir mystics and helped clarify an earlier omen, revealing that Ohn'ahra is in danger.

You met Clan Nokhud, the warriors, and sparred with them.

You met the emerald emissary, Gemisath, and learned that the green dragons needed the centaurs' aid to push back a Primalist threat. As the centaur leader, the Khanam Matra, agreed to help Gemisath, the Nokhud Khan Balakar arrived and killed Gemisath, throwing his lot in with the Primalists. You defeated his forces that launched an attack on Maruukai.
You found a group of tuskarr willing to help investigate the ley lines and tracked down a caravan traveling with the tuskarr chieftain, Brena.
After helping restore some of the crumbling embassy's facilities--and signing the visitor's log, of course--you convinced Sendrax to fire her emergency flare to get the attention of the dragons.
Impatient and unwilling to wait, Wrathion began his assault of the Obsidian Citadel, despite being badly outnumbered by the djaradin forces he sought to drive off.
You helped Commander Lethanak and Sendrax save the injured civilians and whelplings from the djaradin attack.
After empowering the Obsidian Oathstone, Wrathion and Sabellian argued over who should be the one to sit on the throne as Aspect and lead the newly restored black dragonflight.
After travelling to Vakthros, you met up with Khadgar and Kalecgos and worked to fight back the Primalist forces and get to the tower to confront Raszageth.

At the Azure Archives, you watched as Kalecgos attempted to summon the scattered blue dragonflight. Suddenly Khadgar arrived with dire news--Raszageth herself had arrived to take down an ancient tower called Vakthros, an act that Sindragosa said would destroy not only the tower, but the Azure Span along with it.
You arrived at the Azure Span to help the Kirin Tor and Kalecgos, the aspect of the blue dragons, track down the Azure Oathstone.

In a last attempt to save Chromie, you raced through time itself, following her deeper into Azeroth's past. Your headlong rush ended in a time before the Titans, when the Old Gods fought the Elementals lords at the height of their power. You reached the Black Empire.

Finally able to stabilize Chromie, you recieved some unexpected assistance from Eternus in returning to the present. For her help, Eternus was allowed to fly free.  The future remained very clouded for Nozdormu.

Your actions restored the Bonze Oathstone and you were sent to inform Alexstrasza in Valdrakken.
You sought out Sendrax at the Life-Binder Conservatory, healing injured dragonkin along the way.

The Khanam Matra shared that she must blow the ancient Horn of Drusahl to answer the dragons' call for an alliance, but she needs Ohn'ahra's blessing. She sent you to her clan's home to ready her forces for war and connect with the mystics.

You spread the news of war and meet Boku, an anxious mystic who cannot hear Ohn'ahra. You accompanied him to find the other mystics at Ridgewater Retreat and find that Clan Nokhud has attacked. After saving some of the initiates, the Ohn'ir leader Tigari Khan sent you and Boku to find Ohn'ahra.

You discovered the Primalists and Nokhud attacking Windsong Rise as Koroleth tried to capture Ohn'ahra. Though you attempted to stop her, Koroleth knocked the two of you off the cliff and out of her way.

Lord Commander Turalyon appointed Toddy Whiskers to co-lead the Dragonscale Expedition, a joint Horde-Alliance effort to explore the Dragon Isles. Together, you helped rally the many skilled scholars, artisans, and explorers needed to ensure the success of the expedition in the Dragon Isles.
You were summoned to Stormwind by the black dragon Wrathion. There, Wrathion presented Alexstrasza's invitation to the Alliance to join the dragonflights on the Dragon Isles.

You sailed with Toddy and the Dragonscale Expedition to the Dragon Isles on the Rugged Dragonscale, a Kul Tiran ship commissioned for this adventure.

Upon arriving in the Waking Shore, you discovered proto-dragons had swarmed the expedition's landing site. While rescuing expedition members, you fought off the proto-dragons and helped secure the Dragonscale Expedition's camp in the nearby Wingrest Embassy.

Working with Brena and Kalecgos, you put the spirits of fallen tuskarr to rest and worked to bring down an Ancient that the gnolls were withering away with decay. After successfully defeating the Ancient, Kalecgos was able to repair the ley line.

With the combined strength of Wrathion's mortal army and Sabellian's dragon army, the pair of black dragons were able to force their way into the Obsidian Citadel to reforge the Obsidian Oathstone and successfully empower it.

At Nozdormu's request, you traveled to the Shifting Sands to speak with Chromie. She informed you that an attack by the Infinite Flight had disabilized time in the region, and asked you to assist the Timewalkers in restoring order. 

After rescuing novice timewalker Siaszerathel, you were trained in the use of Timewalker tools by the more senior Andantenormu. Results were mixed, but mostly positive. With the Shifting Sands under control, you all turned your attention to the Temporal Conflux.
While preparing to set sail for the Dragon Isles, Archmage Khadgar arrived with troubling news of Raszageth, a powerful storm proto-dragon who leads the Primalists against the dragonflights.

A drakonid emissary named Rymek arrived at the Emerald Gardens and earned the trust of the green dragonflight. Through an act of betrayal, he revealed himself as a Primalist, invading the Emerald Dream to search for the nascent World Tree.

Now that Malfurion Stormrage has taken Ysera's place in Ardenweald, the former green Aspect has returned to the Emerald Dream. We have reunited the green dragonflight and defeated Rymek. Growing in power, Merithra now leads as the new Dreamer.
Majordomo Selistra hurriedly flew you and the rescued egg to Queen Alexstrasza at the Ruby Lifeshrine.

Queen Alexstrasza welcomed the eggs, but made it clear she would not interfere with Wrathion and Sabellian's bickering over the throne.

With eggs of all five great dragonflights finally restored to the Ruby Life Pools, the red dragonflight's purpose was once more fulfilled and their Oathstone was successfully empowered.

You next tried to stabilize Chromie in a strange, alternate past. Azmerloth.

You made further progress in stabilize Chromie, but she was pulled away before you could finish. While in this strange, murloc ruled world, you met yourself. Or a version of yourself at least. Together you fought against the Deathlings and took down the finned aspect of death before returning to Nozdormu.

Sindragosa informed you and Kalecgos that the Azure Oathstone could not be empowered until the ley lines within the Azure Span were repaired.

You set off to find the tuskarr within Azure Span for better guidance regarding the location of the ley lines.

You accompanied the Khanam Matra to the Horn of Drusahl, but the Nokhud had taken it over. You witnessed Balakar use Ohn'ahra's power to blow the Horn and draw out the dragons. The Nokhud tried to kill their leader, Merithra, with a storm-infused ballista bolt, but one of her own took the hit for her.

You met Merithra and agreed to help. You rallied her forces and met them and the centaur at the Primalist Front. You helped them defeat the Primalists and take down Koroleth.

Merithra invited you and the centaur khans to the Oathstone. They renewed their ancient pact, allowing Merithra to activate the Oathstone.

You travelled with Brena and Norukk to Brackenhide Hollow, where you met up with one of Kalecgos's mirror images. One of the ley lines he sought to repair was in the thick of Brackenhide Hollow. Kalecgos and Brena decided to help each other by hunting down the source of the decay and getting rid of it.

At the Lifeshrine, you learned much about the goals and culture of the red dragonflight, who cultivate life and tend to the eggs of all of the dragonflights.

You were also introduced to dragonriders, drakes and mortals who have teamed up to explore the wonders of the Dragon Isles together. While training with them, you found your first dragonriding companion, a renewed proto-drake, and took to the skies in style.

At the Azure Archives, Kalecgos was able to successfully empower the Azure Oathstone, vowing to bring his flight back together. After thanking you for your help, Kalecgos departed for the dragon capital of Valdrakken, to let Alexstrasza and the others know what had happened.

Inside the ruins of the conservatory, you and Sendrax quickly found yourselves surrounded by Primalists. Their leader, a massive fire proto-dragon, commanded them to infuse stolen red dragon eggs with elemental power. Despite your and Sendrax's best efforts, the whelplings that hatched from the eggs were beyond redemption, made feral by the Primalist influence.

Sendrax heroically sacrificed her life in order to save the last unhatched egg from the Primalists.
The caravan had been set upon by a group of gnolls, and several members of the caravan were captured. Brena asked you to help defeat the gnolls and rescue her friends.

Unable to resolve the argument, you agreed to help them escort the clutch of black dragon eggs brought by Sabellian to the Ruby Life Pools.

Through a clever ruse, Sabellian ensured the safety of the eggs during transit, and frustrated Wrathion's attempts to curry favor with Queen Alexstrasza.
Majordomo Selistra and Wrathion arrived to inform you that the djaradin, ancient rivals of the dragons, have reawakened and attacked a nearby dragon outpost.

You and the Majordomo were able to push back the Primalists and rescue all of the stolen dragon eggs from the Primalist enclave. However, Queen Alexstrasza was wounded while forcing Raszageth away from the Lifeshrine.

Wrathion, having helped Alexstrasza drive off Raszageth, argued that Alexstrasza and her brood must now help him retake the Obsidian Citadel, the ancestral home of the black dragonflight. Alexstrasza urged patience as she focused her efforts on tending to the recovered dragon eggs.

With matters in hand, Kalecgos was ready to depart, but Brena asked both of you to travel with her to her home, Iskaara. There, Brena gave Kalecgos more information about ley lines in the area, and you participated in the funeral for Ponoliak, the former chieftain of Iskaara. Kalecgos, having learned much from the Iskaara tuskarr, asked you to meet him at the Azure Archives.

At the Temporal Conflux you finally saw the source of all the distortion. The infinite dragon Eternus who was trying to effect the bronze Oathstone. Her presence had triggerd a lockdown which was now holding most of the Timewalkers.

After freeing the Timewalkers, you fought and defeated a massive time elemental. With all your allied forces freed, Chromie led the attack on Eternus. However the Bronze and Infinite magics collided, sending the two dragons tumbling through time.
During Wrathion's desperate charge, a black dragon named Sabellian arrived just in time to help, having returned from Outland with his powerful brood of black dragons.

Upon reaching South Hold, you we met with Primalists actively attacking the garrison. You fought off the invaders and sought out the garrison commander, Eranog.

However, Eranog proved to be a traitor and had sided with the Primalists in exchange for firey power. He disappeared, leaving the garrison in the claws of Magmatalon, who you then defeated.
